summary: Functional Brands Inc. filed an 8-K (Item 1.02) disclosing that the seller, BullionFX, terminated a previously announced Asset Purchase Agreement on June 29, 2026. The agreement, entered on May 22, 2026, involved the acquisition of the Alchemy gold-backed blockchain settlement platform for 100,000 shares of Series D Convertible Preferred Stock. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or break fee is mentioned. The transaction will not be consummated. The termination represents a failed acquisition, leaving the company without the intended asset. Investors should watch for any subsequent strategic pivot or renewed acquisition efforts by the company.
